definition.simple: A chart shape that shows how price moved in one time period: where it opened, its highest and lowest points, and where it closed.
definition.balanced: The thick part is the body, between the open and the close. The thin lines are wicks (or shadows), reaching to the high and low. A candle is usually coloured one way when the close is above the open and another way when it is below. Colours depend on your app settings.

example: Open 1.10000, high 1.10250, low 1.09900, close 1.10180: the close is above the open, so it is an up candle with an 18-pip body.
